description: This file manages a module-level registry for Discord GatewayPlugin instances, providing functions to register, unregister, retrieve, and clear gateways. It handles the mapping between accounts and their respective GatewayPlugin instances, including a default account placeholder.

methods.description: Removes the GatewayPlugin registration for a specific account ID.
